summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, int64 coordinates) pairs with updated docstring; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter patch generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, worker split via np.ceil, NotImplementedError for missing len; PatchDataset np.float -> float in docstring example), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus test_missing_len). Nothing was run: no tests, no formatter, no linter, per instructions. Pinned values in test_loading_array are unverified. Two pre-existing lines in utils.py (get_valid_patch_size docstring) exceed 120 characters and were left alone. Nothing committed.
